title: Oven Roasted Filipino Red Cabbage Lumpia
description: A halal-friendly Filipino dish featuring roasted red cabbage wrapped in lumpia, perfect for a weeknight dinner. The malty flavor and bouncy texture make it a delight to eat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the shredded red cabbage with 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil, salt, and black pepper until evenly coated.
Spread the cabbage mixture on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the cabbage is roasting, heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and chopped onion to the pan and saute until fragrant.
Once the cabbage is done roasting, let it cool down to room temperature.
To assemble the lumpia, lay a lumpia wrapper on a flat surface and place about 1 tablespoon of the roasted cabbage mixture in the center of the wrapper.
Brush the edges of the wrapper with a little water and fold the wrapper into a triangle, pressing the edges together to seal the lumpia.
Repeat the process with the remaining cabbage mixture and lumpia wrappers.
Serve the oven roasted Filipino red cabbage lumpia warm with your favorite dipping sauce.
